g.text: In 2000, 37% of new American houses had a basement. In 2025, 16%. If each part of the country had

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: kept its 2000 habits, the shift of building to the South would have cut that only to 29%. The rest is builders

text.style: font-size: 13.5px; font-family: 'Inter'; fill: #4a4741

g.text: dropping basements where they used to be standard.
